summary.zh: 按任务规模选择团队人数与角色
summary.en: Choose team size and roles for agent tasks

description.zh: 给出团队规模的经验规则和审查、调试、功能、全栈、研究等预设编队，说明每种角色应选用的 subagent_type 与本地显示模式。适合决定要开几个智能体、组哪种团队，或为非标准流程定制编队时使用。
description.en: Offers sizing heuristics and preset line-ups for review, debug, feature, full-stack, and research work, plus which subagent_type and display mode each role needs. Use it when deciding how many agents to spawn.
